typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		DateKey as string,
		Date as string,
		{Fiscal Year} as string,
		{Fiscal Quarter} as string,
		Month as string,
		{Full Date} as string,
		MonthKey as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> sourceDates
source(output(
		CustomerKey as string,
		{Customer ID} as string,
		Customer as string,
		City as string,
		{State-Province} as string,
		{Country-Region} as string,
		{Postal Code} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> sourceCustomers
source(output(
		ProductKey as string,
		SKU as string,
		Product as string,
		{Standard Cost} as string,
		Color as string,
		{List Price} as string,
		Model as string,
		Subcategory as string,
		Category as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> sourceProducts
source(output(
		ResellerKey as string,
		{Reseller ID} as string,
		{Business Type} as string,
		Reseller as string,
		City as string,
		{State-Province} as string,
		{Country-Region} as string,
		{Postal Code} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> sourceReseller
source(output(
		Channel as string,
		SalesOrderLineKey as string,
		{Sales Order} as string,
		{Sales Order Line} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> sourceSalesOrder
source(output(
		SalesTerritoryKey as string,
		Region as string,
		Country as string,
		Group as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> sourceSalesTerritory
source(output(
		SalesOrderLineKey as string,
		ResellerKey as string,
		CustomerKey as string,
		ProductKey as string,
		OrderDateKey as string,
		DueDateKey as string,
		ShipDateKey as string,
		SalesTerritoryKey as string,
		{Order Quantity} as string,
		{Unit Price} as string,
		{Extended Amount} as string,
		{Unit Price Discount Pct} as string,
		{Product Standard Cost} as string,
		{Total Product Cost} as string,
		{Sales Amount} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> sourceSalesData
sourceDates derive({Fiscal Year} = toInteger(substring({Fiscal Year}, 3, 4)),
		{Fiscal Quarter} = toInteger(substring({Fiscal Quarter}, 9, 1)),
		Month = substring({Month}, 6, 3),
		Date = toDate({Date}, 'dd-MM-yyyy')) ~> derivedColumn1
derivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		DateKey,
		Date,
		FiscalYear = {Fiscal Year},
		FiscalQuarter = {Fiscal Quarter},
		Month,
		MonthKey
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> RemoveColumns1
sourceProducts derive({Standard Cost} = toFloat(substring({Standard Cost}, 3)),
		{List Price} = toFloat(substring({List Price}, 3), '#,###.00')) ~> derivedColumn2
sourceSalesOrder derive({Sales Order Line} = substring({Sales Order Line}, -1)) ~> sinkSalesOrder
sourceSalesData derive({Order Quantity} = toInteger({Order Quantity}),
		{Unit Price} = toFloat({Unit Price}, '$#,###.00'),
		{Extended Amount} = toFloat({Extended Amount}, '$#,###.00'),
		{Unit Price Discount Pct} = toFloat({Unit Price Discount Pct}, '#.00%'),
		{Product Standard Cost} = toFloat({Product Standard Cost}, '$#,###.00'),
		{Total Product Cost} = toFloat({Total Product Cost}, '$#,###.00'),
		{Sales Amount} = toFloat({Sales Amount}, '$#,###.00')) ~> derivedColumn3
sourceCustomers select(mapColumn(
		CustomerKey,
		CustomerID = {Customer ID},
		Customer,
		City,
		StateProvince = {State-Province},
		CountryRegion = {Country-Region},
		PostalCode = {Postal Code}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> customerColumnRename
derivedColumn2 select(mapColumn(
		ProductKey,
		SKU,
		Product,
		StandardCost = {Standard Cost},
		Color,
		ListPrice = {List Price},
		Model,
		Subcategory,
		Category
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> productColumnRename
sourceReseller select(mapColumn(
		ResellerKey,
		ResellerID = {Reseller ID},
		BusinessType = {Business Type},
		Reseller,
		City,
		StateProvince = {State-Province},
		CountryRegion = {Country-Region},
		PostalCode = {Postal Code}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> select1
sinkSalesOrder select(mapColumn(
		Channel,
		SalesOrderLineKey,
		SalesOrder = {Sales Order},
		SalesOrderLine = {Sales Order Line}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> renameOrderColumn
derivedColumn3 select(mapColumn(
		SalesOrderLineKey,
		ResellerKey,
		CustomerKey,
		ProductKey,
		OrderDateKey,
		DueDateKey,
		ShipDateKey,
		SalesTerritoryKey,
		OrderQuantity = {Order Quantity},
		UnitPrice = {Unit Price},
		ExtendedAmount = {Extended Amount},
		UnitPriceDiscountPct = {Unit Price Discount Pct},
		ProductStandardCost = {Product Standard Cost},
		TotalProductCost = {Total Product Cost},
		SalesAmount = {Sales Amount}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> renameSalesColumn
customerColumnRename sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: true,
	format: 'parquet',
	partitionFileNames:['dimCustomers'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		CustomerKey,
		CustomerID,
		Customer,
		City,
		StateProvince,
		CountryRegion,
		PostalCode
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sinkDimCustomers
productColumnRename sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: true,
	format: 'parquet',
	partitionFileNames:['dimProducts'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		ProductKey,
		SKU,
		Product,
		StandardCost,
		Color,
		ListPrice,
		Model,
		Subcategory,
		Category
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sinkDimProducts
renameOrderColumn sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: true,
	format: 'parquet',
	partitionFileNames:['dimSalesOrder'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		Channel,
		SalesOrderLineKey,
		SalesOrder,
		SalesOrderLine
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sinkSaleOrder
sourceSalesTerritory sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: true,
	format: 'parquet',
	partitionFileNames:['dimSalesTerritory'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		SalesTerritoryKey,
		Region,
		Country,
		Group
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sinkDimSalesTerritory
renameSalesColumn sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: true,
	format: 'parquet',
	partitionFileNames:['fctSalesData'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		SalesOrderLineKey,
		ResellerKey,
		CustomerKey,
		ProductKey,
		OrderDateKey,
		DueDateKey,
		ShipDateKey,
		SalesTerritoryKey,
		OrderQuantity,
		UnitPrice,
		ExtendedAmount,
		UnitPriceDiscountPct,
		ProductStandardCost,
		TotalProductCost,
		SalesAmount
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sinkSalesData
RemoveColumns1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: true,
	format: 'parquet',
	partitionFileNames:['dimDates'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		DateKey,
		Date,
		FiscalYear,
		FiscalQuarter,
		Month,
		MonthKey
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sinkDate
select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: true,
	format: 'parquet',
	partitionFileNames:['dimReseller'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		ResellerKey,
		ResellerID,
		BusinessType,
		Reseller,
		City,
		StateProvince,
		CountryRegion,
		PostalCode
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sinkReseller
